promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry/layout authority: the edit target
Image 2: Material/style only; not layout

Asset type: production-source concept master for a top-down game sprite: the chassis of a new Tri-Tachyon HIGH-TECH mech line, a medium drone-controller walking machine: it carries and relaunches a wing of small combat drones and shields itself while they fight.

Image 1 is the exact silhouette and layout authority, a grey blockout: fill it in, never move, resize, widen or add to its shapes, and keep all empty canvas empty, including the open channel between the nose prongs where a gun barrel shows. Its shapes: a broad swept delta body with long curved wing tips at the rear flanks; two curved nose prongs either side of an open channel; a lighter arrow-shaped SENSOR VISOR on the spine near the front; a flat lighter rectangular deck down the middle of the spine where a weapon pod bolts on later, kept a plain flat mounting plate. The four dark rings are DRONE CRADLES: recessed circular docking pads with clamp arms and small cyan docking lights, empty, because the drones are drawn separately. The lighter disc at the very rear is the SHIELD EMITTER: a round projector housing with a glowing cyan core. Everything is symmetric about the vertical centre line. Its silhouette is the swept, curved high-tech style of Tri-Tachyon warships: one continuous smooth shell, crescent wing fairings sweeping back over the legs, no hard corners, panel lines following the curves.

Image 2 is material and style reference only, never layout: the Tri-Tachyon hover scout this walker serves beside. Match its finish exactly: clean off-white and pale grey composite panels with fine recessed seams, small vents and access hatches, graphite and dark gunmetal working parts, thin glowing cyan light strips along panel edges, the arrow visor in dark smoked glass with a faint cyan sheen, crisp painted game-sprite finish, light from the upper left. It is corporate high-tech hardware: sealed, smooth, precise and expensive, with nothing exposed: no rivets, no pipes, no bolted plate, no rust or grime, only light scuffs.

Strict 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down view of the chassis top surfaces, the machine facing the TOP edge of the canvas. True transparent background, including all negative space; no ground, shadow slab, cast shadow, halo, glow outside the machine, border, text, labels or logos. Draw only the chassis body: no weapons, missile racks, drones, legs or feet, which are separate layers drawn later.

Avoid: rivets, exposed pipes, tan or olive paint, rust, a framed bomber canopy, a pilot figure, perspective, side view, isometric view, cropped edges, a second machine, text.
agentMessages: I’ll use the imagegen skill to render one chassis image, preserving the blockout’s silhouette and layout.
